task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for ADP-08 at src/design/adp-08-service-task-catalog-reference.md. Define additive SERVICE_TASK configuration semantics supporting legacy url and new service_id catalog reference while preserving EXT-01 behavior. Specify precedence and warning behavior when both url and service_id are present (service_id wins, url ignored with warning). Define execution routing from service_id to catalog lookup, capability enforcement rules using service:call:<service_id>, error handling for missing/invalid catalog entries, compatibility guarantees for existing definitions, and explicit testability mapping to ADP-08 acceptance criteria. Design only; no implementation edits.
acceptance_criteria: Design defines backward-compatible SERVICE_TASK schema extension for url or service_id
Precedence behavior when both url and service_id are provided is explicit and deterministic
Capability and catalog lookup requirements for service_id path are concrete and testable
Failure-mode behavior for invalid catalog references is documented with non-breaking compatibility
Design includes traceability to ADP-08 acceptance criteria and actionable test guidance

result.summary: Design artefact for ADP-08 service task catalog reference with additive SERVICE_TASK schema semantics for url and service_id, deterministic precedence with warning behavior, catalog and capability enforcement rules for service_id routing, compatibility guarantees preserving EXT-01 behavior, and acceptance-mapped testability guidance.
